name: dsh-desktop
description: DSH Desktop - Electron client for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.package: pnpm run prepare:dsh && pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir -c apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run prepare:dsh && pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir --mac -c apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs && bash apps/desktop/scripts/verify-app.sh && bash apps/desktop/scripts/package-dmg.sh
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run prepare:dsh && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win -c apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run prepare:dsh && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux -c apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:all: pnpm run prepare:dsh && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --win --linux -c apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs
